headline: GPU rental prices held flat over the past 7 days across all tracked GPUs, with hyperscaler premiums still wide.
bullets: Every GPU posted a +0% 7-day change, leaving market indexes at $8.50 for B200, $5.40 for H200, $4.62 for H100 SXM, $2.70 for A100 80GB SXM and $1.50 for L40S.
H100 SXM carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +140% ($10.68 hyperscaler vs $4.45 neocloud), while B200 has the narrowest at +77% ($14.12 vs $7.99).
MI300X leads price-performance at $3.62 per PFLOP-hour, ahead of B200 at $3.78, though only 4 providers list it and its $4.73 index sits above H100 SXM's $4.62.
Marketplaces offer the cheapest capacity: Vast.ai lists H100 SXM at $2.67 and A100 80GB SXM at $1.15, while RunPod Community Cloud lists H200 at $3.59 and L40S at $0.79.
A100 80GB SXM is the weakest value per unit of compute at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour despite its low $2.70 index.
watch: Whether MI300X provider coverage grows beyond 4 and narrows its +131% hyperscaler premium, given it already offers the best price-performance.
